• Bharatanatyam is the oldest and major classical dance form of India that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Bharatanatyam is a solo dance performed only by women.
 
 
 
• Kathakali:
 
 
• It is a classical Indian dance form which is a story play genre of art and is the folk dance form of Kerala.
 
• Kathakali is the most difficult style of the traditional dance form.
 
• Kathakali is based on the epics of Ramayana and Mahabharata.
 
 
 
• Kathak:
 
 
• It is a classical dance form that originated in Northern India of Uttar Pradesh referred to as Kathakars or storytellers for portraying epic tales from Hindu scriptures, Mahabharata and Ramayana.
 
 
 
• The Sattriya dance form was introduced in the 15th century A.D by Srimanta Sankardev.
 
 
• It is a classical dance of Assam.
 
• It was recognized as a classical dance by Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2000.

questions.question: Bhootada Kola is a spiritual folk dance in which some rituals involve walking on a bed of hot coal and is practised in coastal districts of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97972b501e5a062009ce4a387bdedf6bc558ff3d273b50c0803cd032bec74ea1.png] 

 
• **Bhootada Kola** is **performed by a trained person** who is believed to have **temporarily become a god himself**.
 
• The performer **displays an aggressive outlook**, dances fiercely, and **performs multiple rituals**.
 
• This performer is **feared and respected in the community** and is **believed to give answers** to people’s problems on behalf of god.
 
• **Drums and music** give company to the dancing and pooja rituals. 
 
• By praying together **during Bhootada Kola**, the **community seeks God’s blessing**, prosperity, and riddance of various problems the community is challenged with.
 
• Bhootada Kola is said to have **some influence from Yakshagana**, a more popular and widely performed **folk dance in coastal Karnataka**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6b2078a210c417e3fb6ead5e1bab3b66eec0a38f4854a5a13ec66ffdc4be62c.png] 

 
• **Bhootha Aradhane or Holy spirit worship is very common in the coastal towns of Karnataka.**
 
• Bhootada Kola is **performed** in **small local communities **in rural parts of Dakshina Kannada and Udupi districts.
 
• Bhootada Kola is not a tourist event and is not advertised much in mainstream media.

questions.question: ______ is a famous dance form of Jammu and Kashmir.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dumhal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dumhal**__

 __
 
• **The Dumhal dance is one of the most prominent folk dances in Jammu & Kashmir, India**.
 
• In the Wattal tribe, the Dumhal dance is performed on certain occasions.
 
• The dancers' tunes are folk melodies that they sing in a chorus.
 
• The men hold a banner, gather in a procession, and march to a designated area.
 
• They arrive at a specific area and plant the flag on the earth.
 
• The Dumhal dance is then performed which revolves around the banner.
 
• **This dance is said to have been created by Shah Sukar Saloni, a devout follower of a Sufi saint known as "Baba Nasim-U-Din-Gazi."**
 
• Shah Sukar created this dance form to honor the Sufi saint.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dhemsa is a traditional folk dance of tribal people of central India-Southern **Odisha **and adjacent areas of **Chhattisgarh **and** Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• The Dance form **Bidesia **is very renowned among the locals in the state, **Bihar**. It is considered the most popular folk dance of Bihar.
 
• **Karma dance** which is also popularly known as **Karma Naachis performed by the tribes of Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Orissa and other regions of the country.**

questions.question: 'Powada dance' is a performing art from the state of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

__
 
• **Powada is the traditional folk art from Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Powada **itself means “the narration of a story in glorious terms”.

 
 
• Th e narratives are always odes in praise of an individual hero or an incident or place.
 
• The chief narrator is known as the Shahir who plays the duff to keep the rhythm.
 
• The tempo is fast and controlled by the main singer who is supported by others in the chorus.
 
• The earli est notable Powada was the Afzal Khanacha Vadh (The Killing of Afzal Khan) (1659) by Agnidas which recorded Shivaji’s encounter with Afzal Khan.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **List of folk dances of different states in India:**

 
 
• **Gujarat **- Garba, Dandiya Ras, Tippani Juriun, Bhavai.
 
• **Rajasthan **- Ghumar, Chakri, Ganagaur, Jhulan Leela, Jhuma, Suisini, Ghapal, Kalbeliya.
 
• **Kerala **- Kathakali (Classical), Ottam Thulal, Mohiniattam, Kaikottikali.
 
• **Maharashtra **- Lavani, Nakata, Koli, Lezim, Gafa, Dahikala Dasavtar or Bohada.
